The petitioner is before this Court seeking the following prayers:
"i) Issue a writ of certiorari or any other appropriate writ or order or direction quashing the order of the Additional District and Sessions Judge Hassan dated 28.04.2018 in Misc. No.08/2001 as per ANNEXURE A.
ii) Pass necessary orders or issue any writ or direction fixing the compensation as prayed for by the Petitioner herein before the competent authority or kindly award the amount as prayed in petition by the petitioner by molding the relief.
iii) Issue any other appropriate writ, order or direction that deems fit to grant in the circumstances of the case in the interest of justice and equity."
2. Heard Smt.Aishwarya Hegde M.V., learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and have perused the material on record.
3. The challenge is to the order of the Additional District Judge at Hassan, passed in Miscellaneous No.8/2001 NC: 2025:KHC:35281 HC-KAR rejecting the claim of the petitioner seeking enhancement of compensation.
4.

6. Reserving such liberty, the petition stands disposed.
The originals appended to the petition may be returned to the petitioner, forthwith.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The petitioner is before this Court seeking the following prayers:
"i) Issue a writ of certiorari or any other appropriate writ or order or direction quashing the order of the Additional District and Sessions Judge Hassan dated 28.04.2018 in Misc. No.08/2001 as per ANNEXURE A.
ii) Pass necessary orders or issue any writ or direction fixing the compensation as prayed for by the Petitioner herein before the competent authority or kindly award the amount as prayed in petition by the petitioner by molding the relief.
iii) Issue any other appropriate writ, order or direction that deems fit to grant in the circumstances of the case in the interest of justice and equity."
2. Heard Smt.Aishwarya Hegde M.V., learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and have perused the material on record.
3. The challenge is to the order of the Additional District Judge at Hassan, passed in Miscellaneous No.8/2001 NC: 2025:KHC:35281 HC-KAR rejecting the claim of the petitioner seeking enhancement of compensation.
4.
Against the said order, the Writ Petition is not entertainable.
The petitioner has to prefer Miscellaneous First Appeal.
5. In that light, the petitioner seeks leave of this Court to withdraw the petition and prefer Miscellaneous First Appeal calling in question the order of the concerned Court.
6. Reserving such liberty, the petition stands disposed.
The originals appended to the petition may be returned to the petitioner, forthwith.
